title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ الددو يحاضر في الكويت عن أثر علوم اللغة في فهم أحكام الكتاب والسنة
title_en: His Eminence Sheikh al-Dedew Lectures in Kuwait on the Effect of the Language Sciences on Understanding the Rulings of the Book and the Sunnah
body_ar:
ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو أمس السبت 29 محرم 1433 الموافق: 24/12/2011 بمقر مركز "مجدد" لتكوين العلماء وحفظة القرآن بدولة الكويت محاضرة علمية، تحت عنوان: "أثر علوم اللغة في فهم أحكام الكتاب والسنة".

وفي هذه المحاضرة تناول الشيخ بالتفصيل آثار مختلف علوم اللغة (النحو، الصرف، الشعر الجاهلي، البلاغة...) في فهم الأحكام الشرعية، ودور هذه العلوم في استيعاب دلالات النصوص المتعلقة بالأحكام في الكتاب والسنة، حيث قدم الشيخ من خلال هذه المحاضرة لطلبة مركز "مجدد" لتكوين العلماء وحفظة القرآن تأصيلا لضرورة التبحر في مختلف العلوم المرتبطة باللغة العربية بوصفها الأداة التي تساعد في استيعاب النصوص الشرعية التي يعتمد عليها في استباط الأحكام حسب الوقائع والمستجدات.

تأتي هذه المحاضرة في إطار مشاركة فضيلة الشيخ الددو حفظه الله في البرنامج الذي ينظمه مركز "مجدد" لتكوين العلماء وحفظة القرآن بالكويت تحت شعار: "أيام وليالي لغتنا العربية.. لغة الدين والدنيا" وذلك خلال الزيارة التي يقوم بها لدولة الكويت للمشاركة في فعاليات ومهرجانات ومؤتمرات علمية عديدة.

لمتابعة المحاضرة اضغط هنا:
body_en:
Yesterday, Saturday 29 Muharram 1433, corresponding to 24/12/2011, His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew delivered a scholarly lecture at the premises of the "Mujaddid" Centre for the Formation of Scholars and Memorisers of the Qur'an in the State of Kuwait, under the title: "The effect of the language sciences on understanding the rulings of the Book and the Sunnah".

In this lecture the Sheikh took up in detail the effects of the various language sciences (grammar (naḥw), morphology (ṣarf), pre-Islamic poetry, rhetoric (balāghah)…) on the understanding of the rulings of the Sharia, and the role of these sciences in grasping the significations of the texts bearing on rulings in the Book and the Sunnah. Through this lecture the Sheikh set out for the students of the "Mujaddid" Centre for the Formation of Scholars and Memorisers of the Qur'an a grounding in the necessity of deep mastery of the various sciences connected with the Arabic language, as the instrument that assists in grasping the texts of the Sharia relied on in deriving rulings according to the facts of cases and to newly arising matters.

This lecture comes within the participation of His Eminence Sheikh al-Dedew, may God preserve him, in the programme organised by the "Mujaddid" Centre for the Formation of Scholars and Memorisers of the Qur'an in Kuwait under the banner: "Days and nights of our Arabic language — the language of religion and of the world", during the visit he is making to the State of Kuwait to take part in numerous scholarly events, festivals and conferences.

flags.arabic: في استباط الأحكام حسب الوقائع والمستجدات
flags.context: what the texts of the Sharia are relied on for
options: read as استنباط ('deriving') and translate accordingly, as done here
leave the form as it stands with no rendering
flags.note: استباط is not a word; the term required is استنباط, the technical uṣūl term for deriving a ruling from a text, and a nūn has dropped out. The reading is not in doubt, but the repair is in the English only: body_ar preserves the source's form, per style guide section 11.

flags.arabic: أثر علوم اللغة في فهم أحكام الكتاب والسنة
flags.context: the lecture title, and the record's only statement of its argument
options: the effect of the language sciences on understanding the rulings
the impact of the linguistic sciences on the comprehension of rulings
the bearing of Arabic philology on juristic interpretation
flags.note: This is the Sheikh's usuli argument in its compressed form and the corpus will meet it repeatedly: that the linguistic disciplines are the instrument by which the legal import of a text is established. The plainest rendering is kept. Option 3 would be more idiomatic for an academic reader but replaces علوم اللغة, a named curriculum of disciplines named in the next paragraph, with a discipline name of the translator's choosing.

نحو is narrower than 'grammar' and wider than 'syntax'; صرف is morphology exactly; بلاغة covers what English splits between rhetoric and stylistics. الشعر الجاهلي is 'pre-Islamic poetry' rather than a transliteration, since جاهلي as 'of the age of ignorance' would carry a judgement the term no longer makes in this usage. The house rule of plain English with the Arabic bracketed is applied, which rules out option 3.

options: the "Mujaddid" Centre for the Formation of Scholars and Memorisers of the Qur'an
the Mujaddid Centre for Training Scholars and Qur'an Memorisers
the Mujaddid Centre (its own English name, if it has one)
flags.note: مجدد is 'renewer', the word used of the one raised up every hundred years to renew the religion — the same idea that appears in record 759 of this span. It is kept as a name in quotation marks, as the source has it, rather than translated. تكوين العلماء is rendered 'the Formation of Scholars' to match the rendering of the Sheikh's own Centre used throughout the corpus.

translator_notes: A news report of a lecture. It describes the lecture's argument in general terms and gives no example and no ruling, so the five-rulings mapping of style guide section 3 is not engaged. أحكام is rendered 'rulings' in its ordinary plural sense.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date and is not evidence of when the report was written. The body's hijri and Gregorian dates agree with each other and with the day named.
The lecture itself exists as audio at the link recorded in source_download_link; this record is a report of it, not a text of it.
The closing 'to follow the lecture click here' is the site's navigation furniture; preserved in body_ar, recorded in source_download_link, omitted from body_en.
